key_insight: Tailoring the optical pump makes topological photonic entangled states programmable in dimensionality and modal structure while preserving their topological character.
engineering_relevance: Programmable silicon photonic sources could supply application-specific entangled states for high-dimensional quantum communication, networking and photonic quantum computing.
method: Fabricate silicon photonic superlattices supporting co-localized topological interface modes.
Inverse-engineer nonlinear pump profiles using coherent input superpositions.
Target biphoton eigenstates, spatial correlations and Schmidt dimensionalities.
evidence_signal: Experiments demonstrate targeted state preparation, with site-resolved two-photon correlations reproducible across nominally identical devices despite fabrication-induced disorder.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify state fidelity, generation efficiency or scalability, leaving practical system performance uncertain.
paper_title: Programmable Preparation of Topological Entangled States
